# Portadas — Set de Prompts (Copiar/Pegar)

Formato sugerido: cuadrado 1:1 (3000x3000px) para Spotify/streaming.

---

### 1. Fotográfico/atmosférico
**Prompt (EN):**
Close-up silhouette of a couple almost touching foreheads, warm amber and deep red lighting, smoke or steam in the air, shallow depth of field, cinematic album cover photography, moody and intimate, no explicit content

**Texto (ES):** "Me Vuelves Loco" — script dorada, esquina inferior.

---

### 2. Iconografía / símbolos
**Prompt (EN):**
Minimalist album cover, single red rose with a drop of water on the petals, dark velvet background, soft studio lighting, elegant and sensual symbolism, high contrast

**Texto (ES):** título en serif delgada blanca, centrado abajo.

---

### 3. Tipográfico puro
**Prompt (EN):**
Bold neon typography album cover, glowing pink and purple gradient letters, dark background, R&B album aesthetic, minimalist, no people

**Texto (ES):** "ESA LENGUA DULCE" — efecto neón/glitch como elemento principal.

---

### 4. Retro / vinilo soul-R&B 70s-80s
**Prompt (EN):**
Retro 1980s R&B album cover style, warm gradient sunset colors, grainy film texture, vintage vinyl aesthetic, silhouette of two hands almost touching, nostalgic and romantic

**Texto (ES):** tipografía vintage curva, estilo Marvin Gaye/Sade.

---

### 5. Abstracto/sensorial
**Prompt (EN):**
Abstract fluid art, deep red and black liquid swirls merging together, sensual and organic shapes, glossy texture, dramatic lighting, album cover style

**Texto (ES):** una sola palabra grande, minimalista.

---

### 6. Meme/humor
**Prompt (EN):**
Retro pulp romance novel cover parody, exaggerated dramatic pose, bold comic-style text bubble, campy and playful, saturated colors

**Texto (ES):** "Advertencia: contenido dulce" — estilo cómic.

---

### 7. Doble exposición
**Prompt (EN):**
Double exposure album cover, silhouette of a face merged with a nighttime city skyline reflected in water, deep blue and magenta tones, dreamy and romantic, artistic photography style

**Texto (ES):** título fino blanco, en la base de la silueta.

---

### 8. Pintura al óleo / clásico renacentista moderno
**Prompt (EN):**
Oil painting style album cover, chiaroscuro lighting like a Baroque portrait, close-up of lips near an ear whispering, rich burgundy and gold tones, classical fine art aesthetic, tasteful and elegant

**Texto (ES):** serif clásica dorada, como firma de cuadro.

---

### 9. Recorte de revista / collage vintage
**Prompt (EN):**
Vintage magazine collage style album cover, cut-out paper textures, retro pink and red color blocks, 1970s soul album aesthetic, torn paper edges, playful and tactile

**Texto (ES):** letras recortadas tipo collage, desordenadas pero legibles.

---

### 10. Minimalismo geométrico
**Prompt (EN):**
Minimalist geometric album cover, two overlapping circles forming a Venn diagram in red and black, clean flat design, modern graphic design aesthetic, lots of negative space

**Texto (ES):** sans-serif ultra fina, centrada en espacio negativo.

---

### 11. Vapor / humo como metáfora
**Prompt (EN):**
Macro photography of red smoke or ink diffusing in water, sensual organic movement, dark background, dramatic studio lighting, high-end album cover aesthetic

**Texto (ES):** pequeño, integrado en el humo con opacidad baja.

---

### 12. Ilustración de línea continua
**Prompt (EN):**
Single continuous line art illustration of two intertwined figures, minimalist black line on cream background, elegant and sensual, modern art gallery poster style

**Texto (ES):** manuscrita fina, parte inferior.

---

### 13. Neón urbano / synth-R&B nocturno
**Prompt (EN):**
Nighttime urban album cover, neon pink and blue reflections on wet pavement, empty street with glowing signs, cinematic mood, moody synth-R&B aesthetic, no people visible

**Texto (ES):** integrado como letrero de neón real en la escena.

---

### 14. Textura de tela / terciopelo
**Prompt (EN):**
Close-up macro texture of red velvet fabric with soft folds and shadows, luxurious and sensual, studio lighting, high-end album cover background

**Texto (ES):** bordado o grabado en relieve, dorado sutil.
